errors.text: Williamson-Hall line-broadening analysis primarily measures microstrain and coherent domain size, not mean-square atomic displacement; diffraction Debye-Waller factors, PDF-derived displacement parameters, or simulation trajectories are needed for the proposed displacement comparison.

A high-frequency DOS shift does not by itself demonstrate higher phonon group velocity or a longer scattering time, so the proposed measurements do not cleanly distinguish reduced scattering from percolative transport.
